name: Musée du quai Branly
description: museum for the traditional art of Africa, Asia, Oceania, and the Americas in Paris, France

summary.text: The Musée du Quai Branly – Jacques Chirac is an art museum located in Paris, France. The museum, designed by French architect Jean Nouvel, features the indigenous art and cultures of Africa, Asia, Oceania, and the Americas.
